note: Majority: not read; Vanuatu's Parliament site didn't answer and PacLII refused this client; null. Work: Employment Act [Cap. 160], Consolidated Edition 2019 (commenced 30 May 1983, amended to Act 16 of 2016), read by eye in the scanned copy the Vanuatu Chamber of Commerce and Industry publishes (no text layer; held as a secondary source since the official sites refused): section 38: no person under twelve may be employed in any capacity, save light work in a family-run agricultural undertaking; section 39: a person under fourteen may not be employed save light agricultural or domestic work beside members of the employer's family or agricultural light work done collectively by the community; section 40: under fifteen, not in an industrial undertaking (save as the Commissioner approves) or on a ship; sections 41 and 42: under eighteen, not at night in industry (from sixteen with a labour officer's consent) and not on a ship without a medical certificate. So the general age is 14 (my reading). Performers: no exception or permit for performing is named, so barred under fourteen (my reading). The ILO's Child Labour Observatory profile reads the Act the same way (minimum employment age fourteen). Service: the same ILO profile says Vanuatu has no regular army and enforces no conscription (the Vanuatu Mobile Force is a volunteer unit under the police), but no law on it was read; null.

sources.title: Vanuatu Chamber of Commerce and Industry: Employment Act [Cap. 160], Consolidated Edition 2019 (scan)
sources.said: No person under the age of 12 years shall be employed in any capacity, except on light work suitable to his capacity in an agricultural undertaking owned and managed by the family of which he is a member. ... A person under the age of 14 years shall not be employed except on light work of an agricultural or domestic character in which members of the employer's family are employed with him, or on agricultural light work carried on collectively by the local community.

sources.title: ILO Child Labour Observatory: Country profile Vanuatu
sources.said: The Employment Act establishes the minimum employment age at 14.
